channel.title: Violations Watch: Niger
channel.description: New incidents reported in Niger. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Armed men kill dozens of civilians, including women and children, near Téra, Tillabéri region, Niger; a resident gives 37 dead
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Téra, Tillabéri, Niger. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed men. Reported casualties: 37-38 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Toll from a single resident; perpetrator not identified. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0635
